card.name: Linking words before patient conditions
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as with, of, after, for and in, plus the space before a number, in drug-label dosing and indication sentences. They sit right before a disease, drug name or dose value.

modes.label: Linking word before condition
modes.description: Words like with, after or for that come between a patient group and a disease or indication.
modes.example: hospitalization in adults<< with>> chronic kidney disease at risk of progression.

modes.label: Space or digit before a number
modes.description: A blank or the first digit just before a dose or percentage value.

card.plain: It fires on the small connecting words in label sentences, just before the disease or dose is named.
